description: Learn at your own pace with flexible one-on-one lessons tailored to your goals, available both online and at the academy.
blocks: Learn at your own pace with flexible one-on-one lessons tailored to your goals, available both online and at the academy.

At Levels Language Academy, individual lessons are available on a continuous basis for all courses. Flexible in format, sessions can be held either on-site at the academy or online, allowing students to choose the mode of study that best suits their schedule and needs.
Each lesson is a minimum of 1 hour in duration, with programs designed to provide personalized attention, targeted feedback, and tailored learning strategies.
